title: Supercharged Datapack
description: This datapack adds copper gear and supercharged mechanics
body:
# Supercharged Datapack
This datapack attempts to adds more usability to copper by adding new features and mechanics around the ore and thunderstorms.
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/q4nMmqA1MPo" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## ⚡ Charge yourself up with the copper armor!
Add more usability to copper in your worlds by using them for armor and gear as a middle-term of iron and gold. Channel the power of electricity on your favor!.. at a considerable cost...
![Player equipped with a copper set, as well as copper ore behind the player](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/926f19a860b6d48c0ef647c8ded8d3b88b9485ea.png)

## ⚡⚡ Thunderstorms are more unpredictable!
Entities are more likely to be struck by lightning when exposed to rain, watch out for way stronger mobs!
![A screenshot of two skeletons, right skeleton is normal, whilst the left one is emitting particles, indicating a supercharged mob](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/19933a8d31b3e12009eac1249d9f743310ca2d51_0.webp)
